verdict.rationale: Workable documents a webhook subscription endpoint where integrators register their own service to receive event notifications, with an args object to filter which candidate events are delivered. The evidence implies candidate and employee events, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: a documented full event catalog, payload format, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can use this endpoint to register your service. The args object can be used to further filter which candidate events you want to receive.
You can subscribe to an event and Workable will notify you when it's triggered.
